scope: USA v1.0, native data loading. VBlank-resolution loader measurements in accelerated headless runs, not monitor/4K latency or full campaign certification.

codec.scope: Open/close and exact replay; this menu probe alone reads no portrait archive.

clear_reload.scope: Original completed-game save, opening skip and mandatory Codec; includes actual RADIO/FACE reads.

movie_entry.scope: Synthetic source-derived s08b/6137 entry, full movie decode/mix counts compared with retail source and historical donor endpoint.

failed_prototype.cause: Unrestricted sector burst outran LoadStageFiles and reused scratch before consumption; replaced with bounded interleaving inside original FS_LoadStageSync.

limits: Original BIOS/ISO discovery, single-sector stage directory initialization and command-completion latency remain timed.
BRF/DEMO/VOX/ZMOVIE are never unpaced. XA-mode reads retain the original clock even in allowlisted files.
Scripted fades, mission-log confirmation and cutscenes are outside loader timing.
No fresh Vulkan execution or audiovisual certification. Existing renderer and modern presentation are unchanged.
ASan/UBSan cover the test runtime, not every generated game function. LeakSanitizer disabled under ptrace; makecontext/swapcontext limitations apply.
Faster loading changes frame-indexed TAS movies crossing loads; re-record or explicitly select fast_loading=false for historical timing.
